name: orbit-handoff
description: Carry the important state from one coding session into the next.

interface.longDescription: Save an evidence-only handoff of your current coding session: objective and phase, meaningful completed work, actual verification, material decisions, blockers and immediate next steps. Orbit Handoff overwrites a local HANDOFF-STATE.md at the repository root, with a hard limit of 50 lines. Its shell writer validates before an atomic replacement and rejects obvious secret patterns. Requires a local or sandbox repository with a POSIX shell and Git; it has no MCP server, external account or network calls of its own. Invoke handoff explicitly. Repository state and tracked documentation remain authoritative. Pattern checks cannot detect every secret; review the proposed content before saving it.
defaultPrompt: Save a handoff of this coding session with verified state and immediate next steps.

publication.release_notes: Documentation patch: confirm public npm installation; the handoff runtime is unchanged.
